words.trans: 1.（飞机）升空的、起飞在空中的；2.（引申）项目/作品成功启动、正式面世
examples: Getting Spylark airborne has been a thrilling adventure.

words.trans: （航空）地勤人员、地面工作人员；文中比喻幕后默默支持、让作品得以问世的一群人
examples: ...the amazing 'ground crew' who have made it possible.

words.trans: n. 手稿、原稿（书籍正式出版之前的手写/打字初稿）
examples: I am very grateful to a number of friends who have read the manuscript.

words.trans: adv. 一路上、在这个过程当中、其间（侧重在做某事整个过程里中途发生的事，不是从头到尾持续不断）
examples: ...or provided encouragement, or just decent coffee, along the way.

words.trans: n. 试飞员（文中幽默地指帮忙试读手稿的朋友）
examples: Thanks especially to Zachary Walkingshaw and Daniel Goody for being willing test pilots and enjoying the flight.

words.trans: adv. 在远处、从远处（from afar 从远方）
examples: ...and the Fortescue family for cheering from afar.

words.trans: adj. 有幸得以做某事（书面、文学用语；be privileged to do）
examples: ...the lakes and mountains we were privileged to call our home.

words.trans: adj. 独自的、单独的、孤立的
examples: ...writing a novel is not a solitary task.

words.trans: adv. 的确、实在、真的。特点：放在句末用来加强前面 very 的语气，偏书面/正式文雅，致谢、书信里很常用
examples: I am very thankful indeed to my editor Claire McKenna.

words.trans: n. 专业知识、专长、专业技能
examples: ...all of whose expertise and wisdom I have hugely appreciated and learnt from.

words.trans: v. 起飞、展翅腾飞；（想法、故事）成型、顺利开展
examples: I want to thank Barry Cunningham for believing that the story could take flight in the first place.

words.trans: adv. 起初、一开始、从最开始的时候、压根儿（常用于回溯最初那一步）
examples: ...believing that the story could take flight in the first place.

words.trans: adj. 随时可用的、唾手可得的、随取随用（原指酒桶龙头一开即来，引申'召之即有'）
examples: Having Barry's creative genius and enthusiasm on tap is a first-time author's dream.

words.trans: n. 天赋、天才、创造力
examples: Having Barry's creative genius and enthusiasm on tap is a first-time author's dream.

words.trans: n. 初次出书的作者——之前没有正式出版过书籍，这是他第一本出版的书；哪怕私下写过很多文稿，只要从没出过书就叫 first-time author。类比：first-time buyer 首次购房者 / first-time visitor 第一次到访的游客 / first-time parent 新手爸妈
examples: Having Barry's creative genius and enthusiasm on tap is a first-time author's dream.

words.trans: n. 沙堡
examples: Huge thanks are due to my family, for all the times I didn't make sandcastles, watch Bake Off or play Catan.

words.trans: adj. 由于、应归于、应给予的。Thanks are due to sb. 是固定书面致谢句式 = 感谢归于某人、向某人致以深深谢意
examples: Huge thanks are due to my family.

words.trans: adv. 慷慨地、大方地
examples: As well as generously allowing me time to write they have enthusiastically shared in the journey.

words.trans: 短语：在……的期间、在……过程中（= during，但更书面、强调整个历程）
examples: ...during the course of several years' worth of summer holidays and days off.

words.trans: 固定表达：...worth of... = 长达……这么多的、总量相当于 X 的（several years' worth of summer holidays = 好几个暑假那么长的时间量）
examples: ...during the course of several years' worth of summer holidays and days off.

words.trans: adj. 坚定不移的、始终如一的（un-否定 + wavering 摇摆 = 毫不摇摆）
examples: Thanks to Lachlan for unwavering interest and support.

words.trans: adj. 坦率直言的、直截了当的（毫不拐弯抹角）
examples: Enormous thanks are due to Chloe, my first and most forthright editor.

words.trans: adj. 敏锐的、灵敏的（acute sense of story 敏锐的故事感/判断力）
examples: ...whose acute sense of story saved early drafts from a number of nosedives.

words.trans: n.（飞机）俯冲；暴跌、急转直下；文中比喻稿件走向失败（save... from a number of nosedives 让早期草稿免于一次次搞砸）
examples: ...saved early drafts from a number of nosedives.

words.trans: adj. 永不枯竭的、始终可靠的、一贯的
examples: Her beautiful, unfailing belief has been rocket fuel for late-night writing shifts.

words.trans: v. 陶醉、沉浸、尽情享受。revel in sth = 沉醉于某事
examples: ...who have patiently walked and talked their way around Spylark's three peaks with me, revelling in the setting.

words.trans: n. 情节点、故事关键情节（推进剧情走向的关键设定/转折）
examples: ...as we discussed the latest plot point.

words.trans: n. 功劳、赞誉、认可（most of the credit should go to... 最大的功劳应归于……）
examples: ...most of the credit should really go to Emma, my wife.

words.word: keep one's feet on the ground
words.trans: 习语：脚踏实地、保持务实清醒（不飘、不脱离现实）
examples: ...my wife, who keeps my feet on the ground, while also pointing my eyes upwards.
words.key: keep one's feet on the ground

words.trans: 字面：抬眼向上看。不止是'面向未来'，更丰富一层：仰望、心怀憧憬、看见更高远的可能性、拥有梦想和冒险精神。可译为'面向远方'
examples: ...who keeps my feet on the ground, while also pointing my eyes upwards.

words.trans: n.（小说的）故事背景、场景（故事发生的时空环境）
examples: Finally, a word about the setting.

words.trans: 习语：长出翅膀；比喻作品成熟、得以面世（the novel found its wings 小说终于展翅问世）
examples: ...without whose wisdom the novel may never have found its wings.

words.trans: n. 火箭燃料；文中比喻强大的精神动力（unfailing belief has been rocket fuel 她一贯的信任是我深夜写作的助推动力）
examples: Her beautiful, unfailing belief has been rocket fuel for late-night writing shifts.
